Canopy prototype — Keller Golf Course

Timber and mown ground taken off the NAIP chip by texture rather than colour: both a fairway and an oak stand are vegetated, but a fairway is smooth and a canopy is rough, and that survives the per-chip contrast stretch that makes absolute NDVI useless. Separation below about 0.35 means there was only one population and the answer should not be believed.
